test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

__No other informations__ was conveyed to him.
solution:
The correct answer is __**No other information**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the above sentence instead of **informations**, it should be **information**.
 
• Information is an** uncountable noun** that does not have a plural.
